date_note: The page gives only its publication day, 25 November.
title: Presumed hack of Querétaro security system under investigation, N+ reports
summary: N+ reports that an alleged breach of the security system of the Ciudad de Querétaro police is being investigated. Officials said someone attempted to breach the system, and investigations continue to determine where it came from. The article does not name the officials or say what was affected.
plain: N+ reports that an alleged attempt to breach the Querétaro police security system is being investigated, and its origin is still being determined.
exec: A presumed break-in attempt on a city police system is under investigation; the origin is not yet known.

validation.note: Only N+ (nmas.com.mx) read; it names no official.
